bundle.shortDescription: Write LaTeX and see the page as it will print.
bundle.longDescription: A desktop LaTeX viewer with the source on the left and the rendered document on the right. The live preview renders as you type with no compiler needed; the PDF view is a real LaTeX compile. A Tectonic engine is bundled, so a fresh install can produce a PDF without a separate TeX distribution -- an existing pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex is used in preference when present.
